hero.headline: Your calmer routine starts with the shelf you already own.
hero.subheadline: Ritora reads your shelf, catches ingredient clashes, and turns the chaos into a calm morning and night plan shaped by your skin.
hero.imageAlt: An open medicine cabinet in warm light, shelves filled with real everyday skincare bottles from different brands.

problem.headline: Good products, still guessing.
problem.body: You own the right bottles and still wake up unsure what to layer or skip. Ritora gives you the decision layer that was missing.

problems.title: Shelf confusion
problems.body: You own great products and still guess each morning what to apply and what to skip.

problems.title: Silent ingredient stacking
problems.body: Strong actives pile up between cleansers, toners, and serums. Irritation shows up long before you spot the cause.

problems.title: Buying over building
problems.body: Most routines don't need another serum. They need structure, sequencing, and safer choices with what you already own.

privacy.headline: Your shelf stays yours.
privacy.body: Ritora is built in the EU with explicit consent and essential cookies only. The points below reflect safeguards already present in the product today.

points.title: GDPR from day one
points.body: Your data is stored and processed under European privacy law. No exceptions, no loopholes.

points.title: Essential cookies only
points.body: Authentication and preference cookies only. No ad tech, no social pixels, and no hidden trackers.

points.title: Sensitive context is opt-in
points.body: Location and profile context only help your guidance when you choose to provide them.

points.title: Verified account access
points.body: Email verification and secure sign-in flows help protect access to your routine and profile data.

howItWorks.headline: Three calm steps from shelf clutter to daily clarity.
howItWorks.illustrationTitle: From morning to night, on repeat
howItWorks.illustrationBody: Ritora treats your routine as a living cycle. Every step carries last night's actives forward into this morning, so your plan stays safe without you having to think about it.

steps.title: Tell Ritora about your skin
steps.body: Share your skin type, concerns, sensitivities, goals, and how involved you want your routine to be. Every answer shapes the guidance you get.

steps.title: Map what's already on your shelf
steps.body: Add the products you use today so Ritora can spot ingredient overlap, flag risky pairings, and tell you what's genuinely missing.

steps.title: Follow a calmer daily plan
steps.body: Wake up to clear morning and evening guidance. Safety rules come first, and everything else is tuned to your goals and your shelf.

features.headline: Everything you need to make calmer skincare decisions.
features.illustrationBody: Every recommendation passes through a deterministic safety layer before it meets your goals. No surprises, no clashing actives, no regret purchases.

featureItems.title: Your shelf comes first
featureItems.body: Guidance always begins with the products you already own, never with a shopping cart.

featureItems.title: Ingredient safety guardrails
featureItems.body: Conflict checks and overlap detection protect sensitive skin and take the guesswork out of stacking actives.

featureItems.title: Tuned to your skin
featureItems.body: Your goals, sensitivities, skin tone, age, and ethnicity all shape every recommendation you see.

featureItems.title: Private by default
featureItems.body: Explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and EU friendly handling. Built in from day one, never bolted on later.

featureItems.title: Learn in the open
featureItems.body: Open, searchable pages for the basics. Private, personal routines once you sign in.

featureItems.title: Calmer daily rituals
featureItems.body: A morning and night view that keeps your routine steady even on the busiest days.

differentiators.headline: Built for your whole routine, not one brand.

items.title: Every brand, not one ecosystem
items.body: Ritora works with anything you already own. No brand loyalty required, no upsells, no sponsored picks.

items.title: Your whole routine, not one product
items.body: Ingredient checks run across every bottle at once, so conflicts cannot hide between steps.

items.title: Your skin, your climate, your season
items.body: Guidance adapts to your ethnicity, the climate you live in, and the season you are in today.

items.title: Full body, not just your face
items.body: Body wash, shampoo, lip care, and hand cream are part of the plan, the same way your face is.

faq.headline: Built to earn your trust before it asks for it.

faqItems.question: Is Ritora a medical product?
faqItems.answer: No. Ritora helps you make safer daily routine choices with the products you already own. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace a dermatologist.

faqItems.question: Do I need to buy new products to use it well?
faqItems.answer: Not at all. Ritora starts with your shelf. It helps you get more out of the products you already own before it suggests anything new.

faqItems.question: Will it work for beginners?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Beginners and collectors overwhelmed by their own shelf are exactly who Ritora is built for. It's a simpler path to a routine that actually works.

faqItems.question: How is my data handled?
faqItems.answer: With care. Ritora runs on explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and secure authentication. EU friendly handling is built in from day one.

faqItems.question: Which languages are supported?
faqItems.answer: English and Swedish are available at launch. You can change your preferred language any time from the settings page.

finalCta.headline: Turn your shelf into a calmer daily routine.
finalCta.body: Create an account in under a minute, or log in to pick up where you left off. Your skin profile, preferences, and routine setup stay in one place.

footer.brandBlurb: Ritora helps you turn the products you already own into a calmer, safer daily routine.
